description: Evaluation framework for Pydantic AI agents using pytest markers, pairwise comparison, and baseline readout reports.
rules: Always use the @pytest.mark.assay decorator with a generator and evaluator parameter
Use PairwiseEvaluator for comparing agent responses against baselines
Run with --assay-mode=new_baseline to generate baseline data before evaluating
Baseline and readout files are stored in tests/assays/ by convention
pytest-assay is designed specifically for Pydantic AI agents using Agent.run()
